name: Eric Aislan Antonelo
descriptionHtml: Professor at UFSC (EAS). Research interests include autonomous systems, imitation learning, reservoir computing, and physics-informed neural networks for modeling and control.

name: Gustavo Claudio Karl Couto
descriptionHtml: Works on imitation learning for autonomous driving, miniature autonomous vehicles, and a digital twin of the UFSC campus using photogrammetry and AI-based visual analysis.

name: Yessica Maria Valencia Lemos
descriptionHtml: Works on temporal modal consistency in learning-from-demonstration policies for multimodal robotic manipulation, with a focus on diffusion-based generative policies.

name: Felipe Carlos dos Santos
descriptionHtml: Works on Bird’s-Eye View generation from autonomous vehicle cameras using transformers.

name: Eduardo Vargas Zummach
descriptionHtml: Works on imitation learning based on generative models for autonomous vehicles.

name: Rafael Bertolini
descriptionHtml: Master’s student in the GSAI research group.

name: Amauri Cunha
descriptionHtml: Master’s student in the GSAI research group.

name: Gabriel Zipperer
descriptionHtml: Studies Control and Automation Engineering at UFSC. Works on the group's open miniature autonomous vehicle platform, contributing to its embedded software and field tests.

name: Carolina Salvador
descriptionHtml: Works on imitation learning and trajectory prediction for autonomous vehicles.
